title: Check Palindrome String
statement: Check if a given string is a palindrome.
inputOutputContract: Case-sensitive comparison; input one whitespace-free word; output exactly yes or no (lowercase).

mistakes.hint1: Inspect the accepts mismatched characters behavior in isPalindrome; the current algorithm is close, but one operation changes its result.
mistakes.hint2: Start by tracing T1 manually. Watch array indices / comparisons / loop boundaries / return values at each iteration or recursive return.
mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of isPalindrome: Use left and right indices to compare truly mirrored characters until they cross.
mistakes.hint4: Concentrate on the expression or branch that controls this mistake: `if (text[left] == text[right]) return 0;`. What does it do on the failing input?
mistakes.hint5: Compare the intermediate state with the expected output of T1. The mistake is in accepts mismatched characters, not merely formatting.
mistakes.hint6: Adjust the faulty operation so that it follows this rule: Use left and right indices to compare truly mirrored characters until they cross.
mistakes.hint7: A targeted correction is to replace `if (text[left] == text[right]) return 0;` with `if (text[left] != text[right]) return 0;` in isPalindrome, then retest T1–T6.
